sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:21

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:21:1
items.html: The making of this Kli is that there are then also given to her the upper Mochin in the first three, and they spread through the whole of her: That is, an upper coupling of AB and SAG is needed to lower the bottom Hey from the Einayim, so that the posterior vessels of Bina and ZON ascend and connect to the degree; and then the upper Mochin of the GAR are revealed, and they spread in the vessels of AVI, where the coupling of the Gadlut of ZON is made; and likewise in ZON themselves, who ascended there in the inclusion of the coupling of AVI — except that in AVI they are face to face, while in ZON this is reckoned as back to back, until they come to their place below; and by new MAN they, too, return to face to face, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:21:2
items.html: Ima and Malchut receive the Mochin — the one Panim be Panim [face to face], and the other Achor be Achor [back to back]: For as long as ZON do not descend to their place and receive the MAN of the souls of the righteous, which return them to face to face, they are still reckoned as back to back, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:21:3
items.html: From there they are extended to ZON in the secret of the Partzuf itself, and afterwards in the secret of a Zivug: For at first the Mochin of the GAR are extended to them in the secret of a Partzuf, namely, in the discernment of face to back, which suffices for the coupling of Ibur, for the sake of the anterior vessels of the souls of the righteous; and afterwards the souls of the righteous ascend as MAN a second time, in the secret of a face-to-face coupling.
